granite boulders and cliffs along the river bed. 

We went to Crows Nest National Park hoping to see a better waterfalls after recent rains, but it was not any spectacular, it was actually less water than I saw it last time in summer a few years ago.

I still enjoyed the walk with a bit of rock climbing for a better view.
